之后的日子又恢复到以前的节奏。

每天修炼，隔个两三天出去巡一次边，练练枪法。空间里的生活规律得很——早上起来挤奶做奶制品，熬奶茶，白天修炼、练枪、鼓捣空间里的地，晚上盘腿坐在床上，继续修炼。两个月的时间一晃就过去了。

王建新的功法进步不小。炼气一层的底子越扎越厚实，体内的灵气从一根线变成了一股绳，在经脉里运转得越来越顺畅。每次修炼，他都能感觉到那股气又粗壮了一点，离炼气二层越来越近了。

随着功法进步，他发现枪法也跟着水涨船高。

以前打靶，一百米能上靶就不错了。现在不一样了——神识放开，五感提升，枪端在手里稳得像焊住了一样。瞄准镜里的目标清清楚楚，呼吸一屏，扣扳机的瞬间，子弹的轨迹好像都能感觉到。

两个月练下来，空间里的枪他轮流用了个遍。AK、SKS、莫辛-纳甘、波波沙、马卡洛夫、TT-33，还有那支宝贝SVD狙击步枪，每一把他都打了几百发子弹。现在不管是步枪还是手枪，不管是站姿还是跪姿，抬手就有，百发百中。

“这功法简直就是给枪法开挂。”王建新心里美得很。

时间到了八月底。草原上的草开始泛黄了，一早一晚也凉了下来。王建新算了算日子，快三个月了，送物资的人应该快来了。

他这几天没怎么在空间里待着，白天主要在外面活动。把青马从空间里放出来，拴在门口。又从空间里放出三只大羊、七只半大小羊，在羊圈里养着。菜地里的菜也留了一部分在外面，该浇水的浇水，该除草的除草。

做这些不为别的，就是做做样子。万一送物资的人突然来了，看见他的哨站空空荡荡，羊没了，马没了，菜地也荒了，那说不过去。

每天挤的奶，他照常做成奶制品和黄油。一部分存在空间里自己吃，一部分慢慢攒着。

修炼也没落下。每天晚上进空间，盘腿坐在河边，引导灵气在体内运转。灵气越来越充盈，小腹位置那团暖意越来越浓，像一锅快要烧开的水，随时都可能溢出来。

王建新一直盼着突破。炼气一层已经这么厉害了，炼气二层会是什么样？他心里痒痒得很。

九月五号这天，王建新正在土坯房里擦枪，听见远处传来汽车的声音。

他赶紧把枪收进空间，拍了拍身上的灰，走出门去。

一辆绿色的吉普车从土路上颠了过来，扬起一溜尘土。车在土坯房门口停了，下来一个干事，三十来岁，穿着中山装，脸晒得黑红。

“王建新？”干事问。

“是我。”王建新热情地迎上去，“同志辛苦了，进来喝口水。”

“不喝了，还有好几站要跑。”干事从车上搬下来几个布口袋，“你的补给，够吃三个月的。白面、粗粮、盐、调料，都在里面。”

他又从包里掏出两块步谈机电池：“电池给你带过来了，旧的给我。”

王建新接过电池，回屋把旧电池拿出来递给他。

干事又从口袋里掏出一个信封，递给他：“你的信，家里寄来的。”

王建新接过信，心里一热，没当场拆，先揣进兜里。

“有没有需要下次采购的东西？”干事拿出一个小本子，“下一次过来就十二月份了。到时候很有可能下雪封路，时间就不一定了，说不定得等到开春才能来。你要缺啥，现在说，我记上。”

王建新想了想，说：“帮我带点调料吧。酱油、醋、花椒、大料、桂皮、香叶，有的话都来点。再带点红糖。”

干事一笔一笔记在本子上：“行，就这些？”

“就这些。”王建新说。

他从兜里掏出早就写好的几封信，递给干事：“麻烦帮我把这些信寄回北京。邮票钱给您。”

干事接过信，又接过邮票钱，数了数，揣进兜里：“行了，放心吧。”

他转身上了吉普车，发动起来，冲王建新摆了摆手：“走了啊，自己小心。”

“慢走。”

吉普车调了个头，颠颠簸簸地开走了。尘土落下来，草原上又恢复了安静。

王建新站在门口，看着吉普车消失的方向，站了好一会儿。

三个月。下一次来，可能就是十二月了。要是下了雪封了路，说不定得等到明年开春才能见着人。

也就是说，从现在起到明年春天，这大半年的时间里，这地方就他一个人。没人来检查，没人来问话，没人管他干什么。

王建新嘴角慢慢咧开了。

属于他的时间，又到了。

他转身回屋，关上门，意念一动进了空间。

The days after that returned to the previous rhythm.

Practice every day, and go out every two or three days to patrol the border and practice your marksmanship.Life in the space is very regular—get up in the morning, milk cows to make dairy products, make milk tea, practice during the day, practice guns, and tinker with the space in the space, and sit cross-legged on the bed at night to continue practicing.Two months passed in a flash.

Wang Jianxin’s skills have made great progress.The foundation of the Qi refining layer is getting thicker and thicker, and the spiritual energy in the body has changed from a thread to a rope, and it is running more and more smoothly in the meridians.Every time he practiced, he could feel that the Qi was getting stronger and closer to the second level of Qi refining.

As his skills improved, he found that his marksmanship also improved.

In the past, when it came to target shooting, it was good to be able to hit the target at 100 meters.It's different now - his consciousness is relaxed, his five senses are heightened, and the gun is as steady as if it's welded in his hand.The target in the scope is clear, and you can feel the trajectory of the bullet as soon as you take a breath or pull the trigger.

After two months of training, he took turns using all the guns in the space.AK, SKS, Mosin-Nagant, Bobosha, Makarov, TT-33, and that precious SVD sniper rifle, each fired hundreds of rounds at him.Now, whether it's a rifle or a pistol, whether you're standing or kneeling, just raise your hand and you'll be sure to hit the target.

"This technique is simply a trick for marksmanship." Wang Jianxin felt very happy.

It's the end of August.The grass on the grassland began to turn yellow, and it became cooler morning and night.Wang Jianxin counted the days. It has been almost three months, and the person delivering supplies should be coming soon.

He hasn't spent much time in the space these days, and is mainly active outside during the day.Release the green horse from the space and tie it to the door.And he released from the space three large sheep and seven and a half small sheep, and kept them in the sheepfold.Some of the vegetables in the vegetable field are also left outside, watering where needed and weeding where needed.

I do this for no other reason than to show off.What if the person delivering supplies suddenly came and saw his outpost empty, with no sheep, no horses, and no vegetable fields? That would be unreasonable.

From the milk he squeezed every day, he made milk products and butter as usual.Part of it is stored in the space for self-eating, and part of it is slowly saved.

He didn’t fall behind in practice either.Go into the space every night, sit cross-legged by the river, and guide the spiritual energy to circulate in the body.The spiritual energy is becoming more and more abundant, and the warmth in the lower abdomen is getting stronger and stronger, like a pot of water that is about to boil and may overflow at any time.

Wang Jianxin has been looking forward to a breakthrough.The first level of Qi refining is already so powerful, what will the second level of Qi refining be like?He felt very itchy.

On September 5th, Wang Jianxin was cleaning his gun in his adobe house when he heard the sound of a car in the distance.

He quickly put the gun into the space, patted the dust on his body, and walked out.

A green jeep bumped over from the dirt road, kicking up a cloud of dust.The car stopped at the door of the adobe house, and a clerk got out. He was in his thirties, wearing a Chinese tunic suit, and his face was tanned and red.

"Wang Jianxin?" the clerk asked.

"It's me." Wang Jianxin greeted him enthusiastically, "Thank you for your hard work, comrade. Come in and have a drink of water."

"No more drinks. There are still several stops to go." The clerk took out a few cloth bags from the car. "Your supplies are enough for three months. White flour, whole grains, salt, and seasonings are all in there."

He took out two more walkie-talkie batteries from his bag: "I brought the batteries for you, give me the old one."

Wang Jianxin took the battery and went back to the house to take out the old battery and hand it to him.

The clerk took out another envelope from his pocket and handed it to him: "Your letter is from home."

Wang Jianxin felt warm after receiving the letter, so he put it into his pocket without opening it on the spot.

"Is there anything you need to purchase next time?" The clerk took out a small notebook. "The next time I come here will be in December. It is very likely that snow will block the roads by then, so the time is not certain. We may have to wait until spring before we can come. If you are missing anything, tell me now and I will write it down."

Wang Jianxin thought for a while and said, "Bring me some seasonings. Soy sauce, vinegar, pepper, aniseed, cinnamon, bay leaves, whatever you have. Bring some brown sugar."

The clerk wrote down the notes one by one in the notebook: "Okay, that's all?"

"That's all." Wang Jianxin said.

He took out a few letters he had written a long time ago from his pocket and handed them to the clerk: "Please help me send these letters back to Beijing. I'll give you the stamp money."

The clerk took the letter and the stamp money, counted them, and put them in his pocket: "Okay, don't worry."

He turned around and got into the jeep, started it, and waved to Wang Jianxin: "Let's go, be careful."

"Walk slowly."

The jeep turned around and drove away with a bumpy ride.The dust fell and silence returned to the grassland.

Wang Jianxin stood at the door, looking at the direction in which the jeep disappeared, and stood for a long time.

Three months.Next time I come, it might be December.If it snows and the roads are blocked, we might not be able to see anyone until spring next year.

In other words, he will be alone in this place for more than half a year from now until next spring.No one came to check, no one came to question, no one cared about what he was doing.

Wang Jianxin's mouth slowly opened.

His time has come again.

He turned back to the house, closed the door, and entered the space with a thought.
